newsitem.title: USA: AIMCO offers to acquire NHP.
newsitem.headline: AIMCO offers to acquire NHP.

text.p: NHP Inc said on Thursday that Apartment Investment and Management Co (AIMCO) agreed to buy about 55 percent of NHP's shares from two companies that hold them, and also offered to acquire the balance of the company on the same terms -- $20 per share, in AIMCO stock.
NHP has formed a special committee to consider the AIMCO offer. AIMCO was trading at 26-1/8 at mid-morning. NHP was at $20 a share, up 4-5/8.
The NHP stock being acquired by AIMCO is held by Demeter Holdings Corp, an affiliate of Harvard Private Capital Group Inc, and by Capricorn Investors LP.
As part of the deal with Demeter and Capricorn, NHP's wholly owned Washington Mortgage Financial Group subsidiary would be spun off on a pro-rata basis to current NHP stockholders.
